title: Positive Čech cohomology of direct images of injective module sheaves vanishes
statement: Let h:X→S be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], and let I be an injective O_X-module [def-sp-injective-resolutions, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For every open U of S, every family V_j of opens with arrows V_j→U and union U [def-sc-zariski-site], every choice C of the iterated fibre products and index maps [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex], and every p>0, the p-th Čech cohomology of C with coefficients in the underlying additive presheaf of h_*I [def-pc-module-pullback] is zero. The index type may lie in any universe max u w.

proof.text: For a tuple t, form the finite intersection B of the opens V_(t k). The inclusions B → V_(t k) commute because the category of opens is thin. The universal property of C gives B → C.W p t; thus a point in every V_(t k) belongs to C.W p t. Define the pulled-back Čech data explicitly by W′ p t = h⁻¹(C.W p t), with projections and index maps obtained using Opens.map h.base. Any open Z mapping to every h⁻¹(V_(t k)) lies in W′ by the preceding pointwise argument. All required equalities and uniqueness follow from thinness. Degree-zero equality is the inverse image of C.W_zero. Inverse image commutes with the union of the cover, yielding a cover of h⁻¹U.

Mathlib scheme module pushforward is sectionwise restriction of scalars: its underlying additive presheaf on W has precisely I(h⁻¹W), and its restriction along an inclusion is that of I along the inverse-image inclusion. With the explicit pulled-back data of Step 1, the products of groups, differentials, complexes and their cohomology are definitionally equal in Lean. No tensor pullback or comparison isomorphism is needed.

Apply module_injective_open_cover_cech_acyclic to I, the open h⁻¹U, the inverse-image family and covering equality, and the explicit pulled-back Čech data. Its positive-degree IsZero conclusion is definitionally the requested conclusion by Step 2. This works for the original arbitrary choice C without replacing it.

mathlib_searches.query: The direct image of an injective sheaf of modules is Cech acyclic for every open covering

lean.statement:
theorem module_pushforward_injective_cech_vanishing {X S : Scheme.{u}} (h : X ⟶ S)
    (I : X.Modules) [Injective I] :
    ∀ (U : S.Opens) (J : Type (max u w)) (V : J → S.Opens)
      (hom : ∀ j, V j ⟶ U), (⨆ j, V j) = U →
      ∀ (C : SiteCechComplex V hom) (p : ℕ), 0 < p →
        IsZero ((C.cohomologyFunctor p).obj
          ((toPresheaf S).obj ((pushforward h).obj I)))
